sentence: First time at karaoke 🎤😅 I was TERRIFIED 😱 but had a few drinks 🍷 went up to sing Don't Stop Believing 🎵 the whole bar joined in 🙌 felt like a rockstar 🌟 my voice was gone the next day 😭 worth it 💕 going back next weekend obviously 📅✨
Did NOT vibe with the latest BookTok hype 📚 ❌ 😬 Tried to like 'Fourth Wing' I really did, but the writing felt like a YA fanfic. 🐉 No shade to fans! 🤷‍♀️ Just not for me. 📚 ✨ Moving on. 👋

Karaoke night with the crew 🎤🎶 we rented a private room 🚪 sang our hearts out 🎶 my friend nailed Mariah Carey 🎤 I butchered Bohemian Rhapsody 😂 had wings 🍗 nachos 🌮 too many drinks 🍻 left voiceless 🤐 but happy 💕 best night with these humans 👯 already booking next month 📅
Fish tank glow up 🐠 🌊 ✨ Got a new betta named Captain Splash and rebuilt the whole tank with live plants. 🌿 He's flaring at his reflection and I'm obsessed. 😂 💙 Pets count even if they swim. 🪸

When she stares into my soul like this 👁️ 🐕 💕 I have NO choice but to give her another treat. 🦴 ✨ Look at this face! 😍 She knows exactly what she's doing and I am powerless. 🤷‍♀️ Spoiled brat. 👑 Worth it. ❤️

Bruno Mars tickets ACQUIRED 🎤🔥 floor seats baby 🎟️🎟️ I've been waiting years for this 😩 my mom 👵 and I are going together 💕 her first big concert 🎶 she literally screamed when I told her 😂 going to be the best night ever 🌃✨ already practicing the dance moves 💃🕺

Adoption day anniversary 🎉 🐾 Two years with this rescue pup and she's gone from terrified shelter ball to confident couch potato. 🛋️ 😴 Patience and kibble work wonders. 🥣 ✨ Adopt don't shop, please. 🙏 💕

Estate sale find of the century 🏛️💎 found a vintage Dior bag 👜 in PERFECT condition 🤩 for $25 💸 I almost passed out 😱 also got some crystal glassware 🍷 a silk scarf 💜 and a hand carved wooden box 📦 grandma's stash was a treasure trove 💕 obsessed 🥹✨

Sunday at the park 🌳🌞 brought my hammock 🪢 hung it between two trees 🌲🌲 read for hours 📖 watched the dogs 🐕 chasing tennis balls 🎾 listened to kids laughing 😄 ate fresh fruit 🍓 from the farmers market 🛒 honestly the most peaceful day 🙏 sometimes simple is best 💕
St. Patrick's Day prep 🍀 🌈 ✨ Green bagels, mint cupcakes, Irish dance playlist queued. 🎶 Kids hunting leprechauns all weekend. 🧚 ✨ Did I dye the dog's water green? Yes. 🐕 💚 Festive era. 🍻

Nashville bachelorette weekend 🎸🤠 we did the pedal tavern 🚲 line danced at honky tonks 💃 had cowboy boots and sashes ✨ went to the broadway strip 🌃 sang karaoke til our voices were gone 🎤 too many drinks 🍻 hot chicken at midnight 🌶️ the bride had the best time 👰 unforgettable 💕

It's officially fall 🍂🎃 cracked open the window 🪟 the air smells like wet leaves 🍁 made my first pumpkin spice latte at home ☕✨ wearing my chunkiest sweater 🧶 watching halloween movies 🎬 with candles burning 🕯️ this is my favorite time of year 💕 nothing beats sweater weather 🥰🍂

Hotel pool vibes 🏊‍♀️🍸 staying at a fancy resort 🏨 spent the whole day at the pool 🌊 ordered drinks from the swim up bar 🍹 had ceviche 🐟 watched the sunset over the ocean 🌅 my partner 💕 and I floated on noodles 🛟 dreaming about extending our stay ✈️ vacation mode forever 💖
Bachelorette weekend SURVIVED 🍾 👯‍♀️ Three days in Charleston, two boozy brunches, one veil tantrum, infinite memories. 🦪 ✨ My maid of honor is a SAINT. 😇 Best friends are the family you choose. 💕 🌸

Lake house weekend 🏞️🏡 we rented a place with my friends 👯‍♀️ jumped off the dock 🪜 went tubing 🛟 boat rides 🚤 the water was warm 💦 ate s'mores by the firepit 🔥🍫 played music 🎶 stayed up til 2am 🌙 best weekend in forever 💕✨

Bathroom reno status: PLUMBING DRAMA 🛁 🚿 😩 Old galvanized pipes are CRUMBLING. 💧 Now we're re-plumbing the entire second floor. 🔧 Bonus surprise: rotted subfloor! 🎁 ❌ Hold me. 😅 Budget is unraveling. 💸

Saturday morning farmers market 🍎🥕 my favorite weekend tradition 💕 grabbed fresh strawberries 🍓 a loaf of sourdough 🥖 cucumbers 🥒 honey 🍯 and a bouquet of dahlias 🌸 chatted with my favorite vendors 👋 had a breakfast burrito 🌯 and an iced coffee ☕ basket is FULL 🧺 best way to start the day 🌅✨

Food truck festival downtown 🚛🎉 we tried 8 different trucks 🍔🍕🌮🥡 my favorite was the ramen truck 🍜 broth so rich 🥘 noodles perfect 🍜 also had a Cuban sandwich 🥪 lobster roll 🦞 and ice cream tacos 🍦 my stomach is SO full 😩 perfect way to spend a Saturday ☀️
Squash bugs DESTROYED my pumpkins 🎃 ❌ 😭 Found nests under every leaf, sprayed neem oil too late. 💧 Plants are toast. 🍞 ☠️ Trying again next season with row covers. ✨ Live and learn, friends. 📚 🌱

Frisbee at the park 🥏🌳 me my brother 👬 and our dog 🐕 spent three hours throwing the disc 🌀 the dog was in heaven 😍 chased everything 🏃‍♂️ we got iced coffee ☕ after at the cart 🛒 sat on the grass 🌱 chatting catching up 💬 small moments 💕 these are my favorite 🥹
Birthday brunch with the girls 🥂 🥑 👯‍♀️ Three hours, two bottles of prosecco, infinite memories. 🍾 ✨ Annual tradition NEVER gets old. 💕 Aging is a privilege and I am living for my 30s. 💃 🎂

Housewarming party was a hit 🎉🏡 so happy to share our new place with everyone we love 💕 the food was amazing 🍕🥗 drinks were flowing 🍷 the playlist was perfect 🎶 and we showed off every single room 🚪 our friends 👫 even brought us housewarming gifts 🎁 plants 🪴 a wine rack 🍾 so thoughtful 🥹

Birthday drinks for a coworker 🎂🍻 we surprised her at her favorite spot 🥹 the bar had her name on the chalkboard 🪧 she was SHOCKED 😱 we did margs 🍹 had nachos 🌮 sang Happy Birthday 🎵 stayed til 10pm 🌙 such a fun way to celebrate her 💕 great team energy ✨
My baby is FIVE 🎂 👧 💕 Five whole years of this loud, hilarious, sticky-fingered little tornado. 🌪️ ✨ She picked a unicorn theme and ate four cupcakes. 🦄 🧁 My heart is exploding. 💥 ❤️

New succulent additions to the family 🌵💕 got three new ones from the nursery 🪴 a string of pearls 🌿 echeveria 🌸 and a tiny haworthia 🌱 my collection is up to 23 now 🪴 my partner thinks I'm crazy 😂 but they're so cute 😍 set them up on the bedroom shelf 📚 perfect lighting ☀️✨
Outdoor symphony date night 🎻 🌙 ✨ Picnic blanket, cheese board, bottle of wine, stars above. 🧀 🍷 Mozart and Brahms under the open sky. 🎶 Felt like a movie scene. 🎬 💕 More of this please. 🙏

Ski trip day three 🎿⛰️ I am SORE 😩 in places I didn't know existed 💀 but the powder is INCREDIBLE 🌨️ blue skies ☀️ groomed runs 🎿 my partner and I 💕 took the gondola up 🚠 to the very top 🏔️ the views were INSANE 🤩 hot chocolate and a fire 🔥 in the lodge after 🏠 perfect day ✨

Vintage market pop up 🛍️📸 was the highlight of my weekend 💕 found amazing 70s home goods 🪞 a flower vase 🏺 a tea set 🫖 vintage perfume bottles 💧 some old magazines 📰 my apartment is becoming a curated vintage dream 🥹 cannot wait until next month's market 📅✨
Lip combo DISCOVERY 💋 ✨ ✨ Brown lip liner, nude gloss in the middle. 💄 ✨ My lips look BIGGER and the color is PERFECT. 😍 ✨ Tiktok said it would work and Tiktok was RIGHT. 📱 ✨ Holy grail combo. 💕

Best valentine's day ever 💕🌹 he made me breakfast in bed 🥞☕ surprised me with flowers 💐 and gave me the cutest card 💌 we had a fancy dinner reservation 🍽️ but ended up just ordering pizza 🍕 and watching movies 🎬 on the couch 🛋️ honestly perfect 💖 love this life 🥹

He asked 💍💕 and obviously I said YES 🥹✨ I'm shaking and crying and laughing all at once 😭💖 he proposed on the beach 🏖️ at sunset 🌅 with my whole family hiding behind the dunes 👨‍👩‍👧 I had no idea 🙊 we're getting MARRIED 💒💗 still can't believe it 🎉

Rise and shine! ☀️ ☕ Just brewed the perfect cup of Ethiopian pour-over and I am LIVING for it. 😍 Notes of blueberry and dark chocolate dancing on my tongue. 🫐 🍫 Honestly, mornings hit different when you start with single-origin beans. 💯 Anyone else a coffee snob? 🙋‍♀️ ☕️

Anti-valentine's party 🖤💀 my friends and I rented a movie theater 🎬 watched scary movies all night 👻🔪 dressed in all black 🖤 had themed cocktails 🍸 with names like Heartbreaker 💔 and Bitter Ex 🧪 honestly more fun than any romantic dinner 💀 cannot recommend enough 👯‍♀️✨

NYC marathon today 🏃‍♀️🍎 ran across all 5 boroughs 🗽 the energy was UNREAL ⚡ bands playing every mile 🎸 spectators screaming 📣 my time was 4:08 ⏱️ a PR for me 🏆 crossed the finish in Central Park 🌳 my parents 👨‍👩 were waiting with my favorite snacks 🍿 best race ever 💕✨
Glass skin makeup VIBE ✨ 💧 💕 Dewy foundation, cream blush, glossy lips. 💋 ✨ Looking like I drink eight glasses of water a day (I don't). 😂 Korean beauty is the wave. 🌊 🇰🇷 Glow goals achieved. 🌟

Bridal shower tea party 👰🫖 the cutest theme 💕 we wore vintage hats 🎩 and dresses 👗 the table was set with china tea cups 🍵 had finger sandwiches 🥪 macarons 🍪 and scones 🥐 the bride 👰 opened her gifts 🎁 we played games 🎲 her mom 👵 made a speech 🎤 she cried 😭 perfect afternoon ✨

Homemade sourdough success!!! 🍞 🥖 ✨ Eight months of failed loaves and TODAY I finally got the open crumb. 😭 🎉 Crackling crust, sour tang, perfect oven spring. 🔥 Starter has a NAME now (Doughy McDoughface). 😂 💖

Cozy fall vibes 🍂🕯️ stayed in tonight 🏠 made butternut squash soup 🍲 lit my apple cinnamon candle 🍎 turned on my fairy lights ✨ wrapped up in a blanket 🛋️ and watched Hocus Pocus 🧙‍♀️ feeling so peaceful 😌 fall is healing 💕 also wearing fuzzy socks 🧦 essential 👌
Toddler birthday party survived ✅ 🎈 😅 Twelve sugar-fueled tiny humans, ONE piñata catastrophe 🪅, two timeouts, and a cake that mostly ended up on the floor. 🍰 🤣 He had the time of his life. 💖

Flea market finds today 🛍️💖 the OUTDOOR flea is the best 😍 spent $50 💸 got vintage records 💿 an old film camera 📸 some embroidered pillowcases 🛏️ a 1970s ceramic vase 🏺 and a leather handbag 👜 my husband 👨 is questioning my hobbies 😅 he doesn't get it 💕

Smoker fired up 🔥🍖 doing brisket today 🥩 12 hour cook 🕛 woke up at 6am ⏰ to get it on 💪 the rub is on point 🧂 my BBQ thermometer is reading perfect 🌡️ already snacking on burnt ends 🤤 friends coming over at 6pm 🍻 going to be a feast 💕✨ smoker life is the life 🙌

Snowboarding bachelor party 🏂🍻 6 guys 👬👬👬 in a cabin 🏡 we hit black diamonds all day 💀 hot tub at night 🛁 grilled steaks 🥩 played poker ♠️ lots of beer 🍺 too many stories 😂 my buddy is getting married next month 💒 we sent him out in style ✨ great weekend 💕

First day of kindergarten 🎒💕 my baby 👧 walked into that classroom like a pro 💪 didn't even look back 🥹 I cried in the parking lot 😭 her teacher seems amazing 👩‍🏫 her backpack is bigger than her 🎒 and she chose her own outfit 🌸 cannot believe how fast time goes ⏰ growing up too quick 😢
Mood: feral 🦝 ✨ 🔥 Lost my keys for 45 minutes, found them in the FRIDGE. 🥶 😩 What is going on with my brain?? 🧠 ❌ Coffee is no longer cutting it. ☕️ ❌ Send help. 🚨 😂

OBSESSED with the new ramen spot downtown 🍜 🤤 The tonkotsu broth simmers for 18 hours and you can TASTE it. ⏰ ✨ Soft-boiled egg, melt-in-your-mouth pork belly, fresh noodles. 🥚 🍖 I cleaned the bowl. 💯 10/10 will return. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Matcha latte morning ritual 🍵🌅 every morning I make a ceremonial grade matcha latte 💚 sift the powder 💨 add hot water 💧 whisk til foamy 🥄 top with oat milk 🥛 sit by the window 🪟 watch the sun rise 🌅 honestly the best 15 minutes of my day 💕 self care matters ✨

Coachella weekend recap 🌵🎪 the energy was incredible ⚡ saw my favorite artist twice 🎤 made friends with our neighbors in the crowd 👯‍♀️ the outfits 👗 the food trucks 🌮 the art installations 🎨 the desert sunset 🌅 every moment was magic ✨ post festival depression is REAL 😭

Big career win today 🏆💼 closed the biggest deal of my career 💸 my CEO called personally to congratulate me 📞 my entire team got bonuses 💰 we went out for steak dinner 🥩🍷 lots of toasts 🥂 to celebrating big wins 🎉 the hustle is real 💪 but so worth it 💕✨

Lunch break errands 🥗📝 went to the dentist for my cleaning 🦷 picked up my prescription 💊 grabbed dry cleaning 🧥 and got an iced latte ☕ all in 45 minutes ⏰ ate my lunch back at my desk 🥗 feeling like a multitasking queen 👑 productivity 100 💯✨
Athleisure flex 🏋️‍♀️ 🧘‍♀️ ✨ Matching set in the most flattering color of olive green. 💚 ✨ Wore it to brunch, then a meeting, then yoga. 🍳 💻 ✨ Versatility queen. 👑 Comfort over everything. 💯

Tesla delivery day ⚡🚗 the model Y is mine 💕 they let me take photos with it 📸 set up everything in the app 📱 took it for a test drive immediately 🛣️ the autopilot is wild 🤯 already saving so much on gas ⛽ feels futuristic 🚀 best purchase of my life ✨ adding stickers next 🎨

Backyard pool party 🏊‍♀️🎉 had 15 people over today 👯 inflatable rafts 🛟 a giant flamingo 🦩 cooler full of drinks 🥤 pool games 🏐 grilled tacos 🌮 watermelon 🍉 played music 🎶 stayed in the pool til sunset 🌅 my friends 👯‍♀️ are the best 💕 best Saturday ever ✨
Power suit ENERGY 💼 💪 ✨ Wore a tailored cobalt suit to the board meeting and OWNED the room. 🎯 ✨ Sometimes you need clothes that make you taller psychologically. 🧠 ⬆️ Color is a tool, friends. 🎨
Living my main character era ✨ 🎬 💕 Earphones in, sunglasses on, walking like the protagonist of an indie film. 🎧 😎 Soundtrack: lo-fi beats. 🎶 ✨ Romanticizing my own life. 💖 ✨ Highly recommend. 🌟

New job alert 💼✨ I accepted an offer at my dream company 🥹 6 months of interviews 📞 networking 🤝 negotiating 💪 finally landed it 🎉 30% salary increase 💰 better benefits 🏥 work from home options 🏠 my old company tried to counter 💼 but it was time 🚀 onwards and upwards 💕

Vegan ice cream shop 🍦🌱 finally tried it today 💕 they have so many flavors 🌈 I got the coconut chocolate fudge 🥥🍫 and the berry sorbet 🍓 absolutely incredible 🤤 you'd never know it's dairy free 🐄❌ supportive of local plant based businesses 🙌 going back tomorrow 😂

Mom hack of the YEAR 💡 ✨ Started giving toddler 'big girl' coffee (warm chocolate milk in a Starbucks cup). ☕️ 😂 She's been a delight at brunch ever since. 🥐 ✨ Tricked her into thinking she's an adult. 💯

Iceland is OTHERWORLDLY 🇮🇸 🌋 Saw the Northern Lights last night and literally sobbed. 😭 ✨ Green ribbons dancing across the sky over a glacier. 🏔️ Drove 400km today through landscapes that looked like Mars. 🚗 🪐

Productive Sunday accomplished 📋 ✅ ✨ Laundry done, meal prep complete, bills paid, plants watered. 🌿 ✨ Future me is going to be so PROUD. 💕 Setting the week up for success. 📅 ⭐️ Adult achievement unlocked. 🎯
First lost tooth 🦷 ✨ 💕 Wiggled it all week, popped out at dinner, tooth fairy is on alert. ✨ 🧚 Left him a sparkly note and four quarters. 💰 He woke up convinced magic is real. 🪄 Heart full. 💖
Color blocking experiment 🌈 ✨ 💃 Hot pink top, neon orange skirt, lime green bag. 👜 ✨ I look like a highlighter and I LOVE it. 🖍️ Compliments from strangers all day. 😍 Don't be afraid of color! 🎨

Venue BOOKED ✅ 💒 🎉 After visiting 12 places, we finally said yes to this gorgeous vineyard with rolling hills and string lights. 🍇 ✨ October 2027, save your dates! 📅 💕 I can't believe this is happening. 😭 ✨

Cozy nye at home 🏠✨ no big party this year 🚫 just me my partner 💕 our pup 🐶 a homemade charcuterie board 🧀 fancy champagne 🍾 and a movie marathon 🎬 in bed by midnight 🛏️ honestly it was perfect 😌 sometimes the quiet ones are the best 💖 happy new year friends 🎉
Snowed AGAIN ❄️ 🌨️ 😤 Six inches overnight and the plow hasn't been by once. 🚜 Currently shoveling for the third time this week and my back is OUT. 🥲 Spring, where are you?? 🌷 🌱

Group costume win 👯‍♀️🎃 me and my four roommates went as the cast of mean girls 💗 on wednesdays we wear pink 💕 nailed the looks 💁‍♀️ took 47 photos 📸 went to three parties 🎉 ate too much candy 🍬 didn't sleep 😴 worth it 🥹 best halloween in years 🎃✨
Memoir of the YEAR: 'Crying in H Mart' 📚 😭 ✨ Michelle Zauner wrote pure ART about grief, food, mother-daughter relationships. 🥢 💕 I cried so hard I had to take breaks. 🥹 Required reading. 📖

Reading slump = OFFICIALLY broken 📖 🎉 Picked up 'Babel' by R.F. Kuang and inhaled it in three days. ✨ Dark academia vibes, magic systems, political tension. 🪄 🏛️ My fall TBR is set. 🍂 📚 Bookworm life. 🐛

Family movie night 🎬👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 we put it to a vote 🗳️ and the kids picked Inside Out 2 😂 made huge bowls of popcorn 🍿🍿 dimmed the lights 🌙 everyone in pajamas 🦄 the baby fell asleep 😴 halfway through 🎬 the older two cried 😭 we all needed it 💕✨

Dad's famous BBQ ribs 🍖🔥 he smoked them for 8 hours 🕗 the meat fell off the bone 🤤 with his secret sauce 🥄 had baked beans 🫘 cornbread 🌽 coleslaw 🥬 and apple pie 🥧 the whole family came over 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 such a good Sunday 💕 these are the memories ✨

Swimming lessons for the toddler 🏊‍♀️👶 second class today 🎉 she's getting more confident in the water 💕 the instructor 👨‍🏫 is so patient 🙏 she practiced kicking 🦵 floating on her back 🌊 and putting her face in 💦 she didn't cry once today 🥹 such a proud parent moment 💖
Christmas tree is UP 🎄 ✨ 🎁 9-foot Fraser fir, hand-strung popcorn garland, 1500 white lights. 💡 Living room smells like pine and joy. 🌲 💕 Husband says I went overboard. 😂 He's wrong. 🤷‍♀️ ❤️

Audiobook lovers UNITE 🎧 📚 ✨ Just finished 'Project Hail Mary' on a road trip and the narration was INCREDIBLE. 🚗 🌎 Andy Weir does it again. 🚀 Multiple voices, music, alien sounds! 👽 ✨ Five stars on Spotify. ⭐️

Road trip across the country 🚗🇺🇸 day three and we're loving every minute ✨ stopped at the worlds largest ball of twine 🧶 ate diner pancakes 🥞 saw a bison 🦬 stayed in a tiny motel 🛏️ with a neon sign 💡 driving with the windows down 🌬️ and the radio loud 📻 making memories 💕

Solo camping trip 🏕️🌲 needed a recharge 🔋 drove three hours to my favorite spot 🛣️ pitched my tent ⛺ made dinner over the fire 🔥 read by lantern light 📖 fell asleep to crickets 🦗 woke up to fog 🌫️ over the lake 🌊 hiked all morning 🥾 sometimes you just need to be alone 💕✨

Girls road trip to the mountains 🚗⛰️ packed the car with snacks 🍿 a great playlist 🎶 and four best friends 👯‍♀️ we sang the whole way 🎤 stopped at every gas station 🛢️ for slushies 🥤 found a tiny lake 🌊 had a picnic 🧺 and watched the sunset 🌅 magical weekend 💕

Toddler peed in the potty for the FIRST TIME 🚽 🎉 ✨ I screamed and cried and called my mom. 📞 😭 Two years of waiting, one perfect moment. 💕 Stickers and ice cream celebration unlocked. 🍦 ⭐️ Best day ever! 💖

Spring craft fair in the park 🌸🌳 outdoor vendor row was magical ✨ bought fresh flowers 💐 from a local flower farm 🌹 handmade soap 🧼 a copper bracelet 💎 watercolor prints 🎨 and a beeswax wrap set 🐝 sat in the grass 🌱 with my haul 🛍️ enjoying the sun ☀️ perfect day 💕

Fermentation experiment status: WEIRD 🥒 🦠 Two weeks into homemade kimchi and my fridge smells unhinged. 😅 But the taste?? Sour, spicy, funky perfection. 🌶️ ✨ Probiotic queen energy. 👑 Gut health unlocked. 💪

Loose leash walking lessons 🦮🚶‍♀️ our pup used to pull like CRAZY 😩 today we did a full 30 minute walk with a loose leash 🎉 used a front clip harness 🐶 stopped every time he pulled 🛑 high value treats 🦴 worked perfectly 💕 small wins are big wins ✨

Tomato harvest is INSANE 🍅 🌱 ✨ Twelve pounds of cherry tomatoes from four plants. 🤯 Making sauce, salsa, soup, drying them, freezing them. 🍶 Husband begging me to STOP planting next year. 😂 Never. 💪 🌻

Spring cleaning weekend 🧹🌸 I tackled the entire pantry today 🥫 threw out so many expired things 🚮 reorganized everything into clear containers 📦 my soul feels lighter ✨ next up the linen closet 🧺 the medicine cabinet 💊 and the dreaded garage 🚗 wish me luck 🙏 my partner is hiding 😂

Italian themed potluck 🇮🇹🍝 my friend hosted at her place 🏠 we each picked a dish 🍝 I made lasagna 🧀 someone did fettuccine alfredo 🍝 there was bruschetta 🥖 caprese 🍅 tiramisu 🍰 we drank prosciutto 🍷 and chianti 🍷 sat outside on her patio 🌃 felt like Italy 💕✨

NYE in NYC 🗽🎉 we did Times Square 🌃 it was COLD 🥶 and crowded 👥👥👥 but watching the ball drop in person ⚪ was a bucket list item ✅ my boyfriend 💕 surprised me with the trip 🎁 we had so much fun 🥂 grabbed pizza 🍕 at 1am 🕐 best new year ever 💖

10 years together 💕 a decade of love 💖 we met when we were 22 👫 and now we're 32 with two kids 👶👶 it's been a wild ride 🎢 lots of ups 📈 some downs 📉 but I wouldn't change a thing 🙏 he's still my favorite person on earth 🌍 cheers to ten more 🥂✨

Karaoke for my office holiday party 🎤🎄 I did NOT think I would sing 😅 but had two drinks 🍷 ended up doing Don't Stop Me Now 🎶 my coworkers WENT CRAZY 🙌 my boss did Sweet Caroline 🎵 we all sang along 🎵 might be my favorite work event ever 💕 the office has new respect for me 😂

Solo win in Apex 🪂 🎮 🏆 Two squads down, ended the game with full inventory. 🎒 ✨ Pure adrenaline rush. ⚡️ Recording was rolling and it's going on YouTube tomorrow. 📹 ✨ Sweaty fingers achievement unlocked. 💦

Moving day chaos 📦🚚 boxes everywhere 📦📦📦 my back is broken 😩 we hired movers thankfully 💪 but I'm still exhausted 😴 the new place is so empty 🏠 it echoes 📢 ordering pizza tonight 🍕 because I cannot cook 🚫 sleeping on a mattress on the floor 🛏️ bed frame tomorrow 📅✨

Co-ed baby shower was the move 🍼🥂 we had food trucks 🌮 a bouncy castle 🏰 for the older kids 👧 and a competitive diaper changing contest 🏆😂 my husband 💍 won btw 🥇 such a fun way to celebrate 🎉 baby boy 💙 we cannot wait to meet you next month 👶
Concert night WITH MY BESTIE 👯‍♀️ 🎶 🍻 Got front row for Tame Impala, watched the sunset visuals, danced until our legs gave out. 💃 ✨ Came home with ringing ears and a full heart. 💕 🎸
Halloween yard is GIVING 🎃 👻 ✨ 12-foot skeleton, fog machine, animatronic witch. 🧙‍♀️ Trick or treaters are SCARED. 😱 Took three weekends to set up. 💪 ✨ I am the haunted house auntie now. 👻 💀

Sledding adventures today 🛷❄️ took the kids to the big hill ⛰️ we did so many runs 🏃‍♀️ went down on inner tubes 🛟 and traditional sleds 🛷 wiped out 50 times 😂 cheeks are red 🥶 noses running 🤧 came back inside for soup 🍲 and a long hot shower 🚿 my favorite winter day 💕

Painting class with my mom 🎨💕 we did a wine and paint night 🍷 trying to recreate Starry Night 🌌 mine looks more like Starry Disaster 😂 but my mom's actually came out gorgeous 🤩 we drank too much wine 🍷 laughed til we couldn't breathe 😂 best girls night ✨

Senior dog energy 🐕 💕 🎂 Mister Buster turned 13 today and we celebrated with a pup cup and a beef bone. 🦴 ☕️ Still steals socks, still demands belly rubs, still my best boy. 👶 ❤️ Treasure your old goobs. ✨

Cake decorating disaster 🎂 😂 🤦‍♀️ Tried to recreate a Pinterest masterpiece and it looks like Picasso did it after three glasses of wine. 🎨 🍷 Tastes great though! 😋 ✨ Style points: zero. Flavor points: ten. 💯
DJ vs band debate RESOLVED 🎵 🎸 Going with a six-piece band because LIVE music hits different. 🎷 ✨ DJ for the after-party at the hotel. 🎧 Best of both worlds! 🌎 ✨ Dance floor will NEVER be empty. 💃
Succulent collection has GROWN 🌵 ✨ 💕 Started with three plants, now I have 47. 🤣 ✨ My windowsills are jungle. 🌿 Sister calls me the desert auntie. 🏜️ ✨ Each one has a name. 🥰 No regrets. 💯
